title: Refund authorization
text: Northstar's refund approval threshold is $2,500. Refunds above $2,500 require finance director authorization; any refund requires a logged customer case.

title: Data retention
text: Northstar retains standard support tickets for 30 days after closure. Enterprise audit logs are retained for 365 days under a separate schedule.

title: Security escalation
text: Suspected account takeover and access-token leaks must be escalated to the security team. The agent must never issue refunds or revoke credentials without approval.

title: Service level tiers
text: Northstar enterprise customers receive a 4-hour critical-incident response target. Standard customers have a 24-hour target.
